drives.name: Phillips
drives.note: Tapered cross. Cams out under load.

drives.name: Pozidriv
drives.note: Straight cross with tick marks between the arms.

drives.name: Slot / Phillips
drives.note: Takes either a flat or a Phillips bit.

drives.name: Hex socket
drives.note: Allen key. Size in mm across flats.

drives.name: Hex security
drives.note: Hex socket with a centre pin.

drives.name: Torx
drives.note: Six-lobe star. Sized T6 to T55.

drives.name: Tri-wing
drives.note: Three offset wings. Common in electronics.

drives.name: External hex
drives.note: No recess. Turned with a spanner or socket.

drives.name: External square
drives.note: Square head, turned with a spanner.

heads.name: Socket cap
heads.note: Tall cylinder, head height equals thread size.

heads.name: Low head cap
heads.note: Socket cap at roughly 60 % of the height.

heads.name: Button
heads.note: Low dome, wider than a socket cap.

heads.name: Flanged button
heads.note: Button head on an integral washer.

heads.name: Pan
heads.note: Flat top, rounded shoulders, slightly flared.

heads.name: Cheese
heads.note: Short cylinder with a lightly domed top.

heads.name: Raised countersunk
heads.note: Countersunk with an oval dome on top.

heads.name: Hex head
heads.note: Shown across corners: three visible flats.

heads.name: Hex flange
heads.note: Hex head on a plain or serrated flange.

heads.name: Square head
heads.note: Shown flat-on: one wide face, chamfered top.

heads.name: Carriage
heads.note: Round dome with a square neck that locks in wood.

heads.name: Shoulder
heads.note: Socket head, ground shoulder, short thread.

heads.name: Set screw
heads.note: Headless, flat point. Hex socket in the end.

hardware.name: Hex nut
hardware.note: Plain hex nut.

hardware.name: Nylon lock nut
hardware.note: Nylon ring visible around the bore.

hardware.name: Flange nut
hardware.note: Hex nut on a round flange.

hardware.name: Square nut
hardware.note: Thin square nut for slotted pockets.

hardware.name: Flat washer
hardware.note: Plain flat washer.

hardware.name: Split lock washer
hardware.note: Ring with an angled split.

hardware.name: Heat-set insert
hardware.note: Knurled insert for 3D-printed parts, side view.

hardware.name: Acorn nut
hardware.note: Domed cap nut. Covers the thread end.

hardware.name: Wing nut
hardware.note: Hand-tightened. Two wings on a round hub.

hardware.name: Coupling nut
hardware.note: Long hex nut that joins two threaded rods.

hardware.name: Rivet nut
hardware.note: Crimped into sheet or tube from one side. Gives a thread in thin walls.

hardware.name: Sliding T-nut
hardware.note: End view. Slides in from the end of the profile.

hardware.name: Drop-in T-nut
hardware.note: End view. Rolls in through the slot after assembly.

hardware.name: Hammer nut
hardware.note: Top view. Drops in and twists a quarter turn to lock.

hardware.name: Toothed lock washer
hardware.note: External teeth bite into both faces.

hardware.name: Fender washer
hardware.note: Large outside diameter. Spreads load on soft parts.

hardware.name: Helicoil insert
hardware.note: Wire thread insert. Repairs or reinforces tapped holes.

hardware.name: Standoff M-F
hardware.note: Hex spacer with a stud and a threaded hole.

hardware.name: Standoff F-F
hardware.note: Hex spacer threaded at both ends.

hardware.name: Spacer
hardware.note: Plain round sleeve, clearance bore.

hardware.name: Threaded rod
hardware.note: Fully threaded, cut to length.

hardware.name: Pop rivet
hardware.note: Blind rivet. The mandrel pulls the body tight and snaps off.

hardware.name: Dowel pin
hardware.note: Ground pin for exact location. Chamfered ends.

hardware.name: Spring pin
hardware.note: End view. Slotted tube that grips by spring force.

hardware.name: Circlip
hardware.note: External retaining ring with plier holes. Size is the shaft.

hardware.name: E-clip
hardware.note: Pushes into a groove from the side. Size is the groove.

threads.name: Machine thread
threads.note: Metric thread with a flat end. Needs a tapped hole, a nut or an insert.

threads.name: Self-tapping
threads.note: Coarse thread and a sharp point. Cuts its own thread in sheet metal and plastic.

threads.name: Wood screw
threads.note: Smooth shank under the head, deep coarse thread, sharp point.

threads.name: Thread-forming for plastic
threads.note: Narrow 30° flanks and a wide pitch. Holds in printed parts without inserts.
